title: 末班渡口
scene: the sheltered wooden pier shed of a small river ferry crossing in southern China at night during steady rain, one warm tungsten bulb hanging overhead, wet planks underfoot, an old wooden ferry boat moored behind them, the dark river beyond
style: unretouched candid documentary film still, 50mm f/4 medium-deep focus, warm tungsten key light with deep night shadows, natural matte skin texture with real pores, zero oily shine, Rec.709 neutral color
soundscape: Steady rain on the tin roof of the pier shed, water lapping softly against the wooden boat.

left.desc: a 28-year-old Chinese woman with shoulder-length black hair damp from the rain, natural unretouched East Asian facial features, wearing a pale yellow hooded raincoat over a grey sweater
left.voice: a soft, clear young female alto voice
left.cast_line: 我叫小禾，从南边来，想过河去看看。
left.name: 小 禾

right.desc: a 62-year-old Chinese boatman with a deeply weathered tanned face, grey stubble and short grey hair, wearing a faded navy work jacket under a dark oilcloth rain cape
right.voice: a low, gravelly older male baritone voice
right.cast_line: 我姓周，在这条河上撑了四十年船。
right.name: 老 周

segments.speaker: left
segments.before: <Subject 1> on the left lifts her gaze from the wet planks toward <Subject 2> and takes a small breath
segments.delivery: a soft, hesitant, hopeful voice with slight tiredness
segments.after: <Subject 1> closes her lips and waits, rain dripping from the edge of her hood, while <Subject 2> slowly looks her over

segments.speaker: right
segments.line: @{reply}这么大的雨，你去对岸做什么？
segments.intent: asks a gruff but concerned question
segments.before: <Subject 2> on the right draws a slow breath and shifts his weight, glancing past her toward the rain
segments.delivery: a low, gravelly, gruff voice with quiet concern
segments.after: <Subject 2> closes his lips and studies her face while <Subject 1> lowers her eyes for a moment

segments.speaker: left
segments.line: 我爸在那边，@{ten}等了我十年了。
segments.before: <Subject 1> on the left swallows and raises her eyes back to <Subject 2>, her hand tightening on the strap of her canvas bag
segments.delivery: a quiet, trembling voice holding back tears
segments.after: <Subject 1> presses her lips together, eyes glistening, while <Subject 2> stays still and his expression softens

segments.speaker: right
segments.intent: gently agrees to take her across
segments.before: <Subject 2> on the right exhales through his nose, and nods once, his shoulders easing toward the moored boat
segments.delivery: a low, warm, gentle gravelly voice
segments.after: <Subject 2> closes his lips and reaches one weathered hand for the mooring rope while <Subject 1> gives a small grateful nod
